features: Sleek Bar Design with Network Compatibility: Premium bar-style phone with a solid, compact build — easy to hold and operate. Works seamlessly with all major Indian networks like Jio, Airtel, VI, and BSNL
Large 2 Inch Display for Easy Viewing: Bright, easy-to-read 2 inch color screen offers great visibility for calls, messages, and menus — suitable for seniors who prefer clear and simple interfaces

Effortless Calling with Senior-Friendly Features: Includes customizable menu to hide unused options, large separated backlit talking keys, and 8 photo speed dial contacts — designed for comfort and ease of use
Clear Sound and Distinct Ringtones: Loud and crisp audio with clearly audible ringtones ensures that calls are easily heard — making communication smooth and dependable

Type-C Charging with Dock Support and Long Battery Life: Charges easily with both a USB Type-C cable and dock charger. The large 1000mAh battery offers excellent standby and usage time without frequent recharging

Block Unknown Calls with Safelist Feature: Only receive calls from trusted contacts up to 50 numbers. Block spam, fraud, telemarketing and unwanted calls with the Safelist feature — a unique safety tool for seniors

SOS Emergency Help Button: Stay safe with a dedicated SOS button. With single key-press, instantly trigger emergency calls, SMS alerts, and a loud siren — critical for timely help during medical or personal emergencies

Health and Wellness Reminders: Set medicine alerts and update health readings easily. Keeps seniors on track with their care routine while keeping caregivers informed — suitable for chronic care needs

Remote Management with CareTouch App: Family members and caregivers can remotely manage phone settings, set reminders, track medicine compliance, and update contacts from anywhere using the CareTouch app on their smartphone

Engaging and Uplifting Content: Features daily motivational Thought of the Day, fun quizzes, and support for 13 Indian languages — helping seniors stay inspired, mentally active and emotionally engaged
